# Solar Arrow — AI/LLM Context File
# https://sa.mktgdime.com/llms.txt

> Solar Arrow is a solar business management SaaS platform built for Indian solar installation vendors, specifically CSPDCL-empaneled vendors in Chhattisgarh, India.

## What is Solar Arrow?

Solar Arrow is a web-based Progressive Web App (PWA) that manages the complete solar panel installation pipeline for Indian vendors. It replaces Excel sheets, WhatsApp follow-ups, and paper registers with a unified digital platform.

## Who is it for?

- Solar installation vendors in India
- CSPDCL (Chhattisgarh State Power Distribution Company) empaneled vendors
- Solar companies managing PM Surya Ghar rooftop solar subsidy projects
- Field survey teams and sales executives

## Pipeline Stages Covered

1. Leads — Capture and qualify prospects
2. Enquiry — Customer interest and site details
3. Survey — Site assessment and technical survey
4. Quotation — Shareable digital quotation links
5. Registration — Government registration and paperwork
6. Payment — Payment tracking and verification
7. BOM — Bill of Materials planning
8. Dispatch — Equipment dispatch tracking
9. Installation — On-site installation management
10. Liaison — Net metering and government liaison
11. WCR — Work Completion Report (mandatory for subsidy)
12. Subsidy — PM Surya Ghar subsidy application and tracking
13. Active — Live solar system

## Key Features

- Role-based access: Admin, Owner, Sales, Survey, Installation roles
- Google Sheets as backend data store (multi-tenant)
- Shareable public quotation links at /q/[orgId]/[quotationId]
- PM Surya Ghar subsidy tracker built-in
- PWA — works offline, installable on Android and iOS without app store
- Telegram notifications for key pipeline events
- Mobile-first design optimized for field teams

## Technology

- Built with Next.js 16, TypeScript
- Hosted on Vercel at https://sa.mktgdime.com
- Data stored in Google Sheets via Google Sheets API
- Authentication via NextAuth (Google OAuth + credentials)
- Caching via Upstash Redis

## Maker

Built by Marketing Dime (https://mktgdime.com), a digital product studio based in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India.
